notes.title: BIG UPDATCHÊ IN CELEBRATION OF FARROUPILHA MONTH
notes.content:
[p]In honor of Farroupilha Month, [i]Gaucho and the Grassland[/i] is receiving a special update that introduces new mechanics, exclusive skins, customization items, and adjustments that further enrich the player experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Magic of the Gaita[/b][/h3][p]The highlight of this update is the arrival of the [b]Gaita[/b], an instrument that players can now play in the game. Beyond music, it also introduces a brand-new teleportation mechanic to travel across different regions of the map. To celebrate tradition, five brand-new songs have been added, which players can perform, enhancing the cultural immersion.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/38dd3a2570b68248bc6ce8ea2c5d57b8b960f901.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Traditional Skins[/b][/h3][p]A set of unique skins inspired by great historical figures and Gaucho culture, such as [b]Bento Gonçalves, Anita Garibaldi, and the Black Lancers[/b]. On top of that, there are new horse skins, hats, and the [i]prenda[/i] dress.[/p][p]These skins can be earned as mission rewards or unlocked through a new CTG minigame.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/79dec0fa8fe476b4a8e3adc280449ef683653710.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/b82b3dda6422317f3dd65a9ee6bafc6f2455d354.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Stylized Assets Inspired by Southern Soccer Teams[/b][/h3][p]You’ll now be able to build your ranch with the colors of the most iconic soccer teams from Rio Grande do Sul![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/93c32ef873a8e01b7883a4b04e4b974ed353ba6b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/97348fbd5835bc127b811906ff3bea57eee61a90.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]New NPC: The Patrão[/b][/h3][p]The [b]Patrão[/b] brings a fresh dynamic to CTGs. After repairing or rebuilding a region’s CTG, the Patrão will appear, and players can talk to him to start the [b]live gaita show minigame[/b]. Depending on how the audience reacts to your performance, the Patrão will hand out rewards for the shows.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/2738e9aeb6f65b3d64a2bf9901e529542b14e878.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/ab65b03882d4a87275f13801a72e95e4cc5e50ea.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Economy refinements;[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to NPC trading organization;[/p][/*][*][p]Enhancements to the customization screen.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/37fe19a70cff9985bad61372c3a3467e525958a3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/8343d12c743122e8de85c9a93b2210d3fb44873c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Mystical Heart of Gaucho and the Grassland 🌾✨
notes.content: [p]Beyond the most iconic landscapes of South America’s southern cone — the beach, the highlands, and the pampas — lies a [b]fourth region[/b]. notes.title: The vibrant and mystical colors of Gaucho and the Grassland
notes.content:
In [b]Gaucho and the Grassland[/b], colors are not just visual elements; they are essential parts of the narrative and gaming experience. Inspired by [b]Nintendo[/b] classics like Mario and Zelda, they bring forth the joy and liveliness of the game's universe. Imagine yourself immersed in a world where every hue seems to leap off the screen, inviting players to explore mysteries and unravel secrets amidst stunning landscapes and mesmerizing colors. 

As you delve into this enchanting world, it's impossible not to notice the influence of lush landscapes and fantastical realms from Nintendo's classic games. The vivid shades of green, blue, and red dance in harmony, creating a setting that beckons players to explore every corner, eager to uncover the secrets hidden amid this explosion of colors. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/4f4eebc827bdc48335c2930733d47f6447a1b80f.png[/img]

But there's also a deeper, more mystical layer within this universe. Stepping into the game's [b]mystical world[/b], we are transported to a completely different landscape where colors evoke the lights of the [b]aurora borealis[/b], adding an aura of magic and fantasy to the game. Here, the hues of the aurora borealis blend in a spectacle of light and shadow, bringing with them a sense of enchantment and wonder. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/2576410899e6fa3c30c72ae068830619f14d757e.png[/img]

From the verdant fields to the landscapes of the mystical world, each color has been carefully chosen to convey not only visually captivating aesthetics but also a sense of emotion and fascination. As players embark on this journey through colors, they are invited to leave behind the real world and get lost in a realm where imagination reigns free. Because, after all, in Gaucho and the Grassland, colors are not just pigments on the screen—they are portals to endless adventures and stories waiting to be told. 

We are excited to share this vibrant and magical world with you, players!

notes.title: The mysteries of the missions in Gaucho and the Grassland
notes.content:
Welcome, adventurers, to the vast and mysterious fields of the game [b]Gaucho and the Grassland![/b] Get ready to enter a world filled with mystical beings, legends, and thrilling challenges. Today, we will explore the exciting missions that await the brave explorers of these wild lands. 

[b]Boitatá: The fire serpent 
[/b]
Our adventures begin with the mystery of Boitatá, a mystical creature represented as an out-of-control fire snake. Its presence distorts the surrounding environment, creating mazes to capture its prey. Those who dare to face it must find their way through the labyrinth and make use of a magical item to calm it down and guide it back to its mystical world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/a85100ff45de064d106d3452b6a783aed1da9fbe.png[/img]

[b]KA'A: The guardian of balance 
[/b]
In contrast, we encounter KA'A, a native entity that seeks to balance the universe through meditation and connection with higher planes. However, his peace is disturbed when a strange event occurs. Those who help him find his artifact will bring blessings to the world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/1bb187da52d471e2a81fdef4a14fe6beca75e98e.png[/img]

[b]Shepherd Boy and the Sentinel Ants 
[/b]
In a plot of rescue and mystery, the Shepherd Boy, godson of Our Lady and the one who finds lost things, seems to have gone missing near a cave that may be one of the colonies of mystical ants. Players must uncover the truth, overcoming challenges and figuring out what to do to free the imprisoned spirit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/fba590fdca83f3e59b2db743b6c747f2b2bfdc41.png[/img]

[b]Rose Mary: Eternal love and sadness 
[/b]
Within a maze of roses lies Rose Mary, a spirit marked by sadness and an endless wait for a lost love, having closed herself off from the world. Only by entering the dangerous maze can players help her find hope and embark on a new journey with a calm heart. 

[b]Ghost of the Pursuer: A relentless quest 
[/b]
Wandering through the rose maze, the Ghost of the Pursuer is trapped in an eternal quest for his beloved, who never loved him back. His shadow haunts the maze, fueled by jealousy and pursuing those who try to approach the one who rejected him. Perhaps one day this shadow may also see the light to move forward. 

[b]The enigmatic Discreet Man 
[/b]
In the shadows of the fields, we find the Discreet Man, a mystery shrouded in secrets. Confronting him reveals an intriguing story of a fleeting glimpse of another world. Players must gain his trust to uncover important information and, perhaps, reveal hidden secrets. 

[b]The troubled duo 
[/b]
Players must help a troubled duo by completing various tasks and finding them in different places before they embark on their next adventure through the fields. But who could this duo be?

notes.title: Discover the thrilling story behind Gaucho and the Grassland!
notes.content:
Explore the captivating universe of [b]Gaucho and the Grassland[/b], a farm simulator with a rich narrative, full of mystical elements, exploration of intriguing worlds, and the quest for harmony in vast fields, along with local legends. 

The story follows a character who, after a bustling life in the city, decides to return to peaceful roots in the countryside. However, upon arrival, everything transforms when the character encounters the spirit of their late father, becoming the only one capable of seeing him due to this special connection. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/095ff5c5c3eb7a2f60e8b6a8fd4e87f0416ef6ac.png[/img]

The father's spirit entrusts the character with a singular mission: [b]to restore harmony to the lands, which have been unbalanced since his passing, and to take on the role of the new guardian. 
[/b]
By donning the father's hat and undergoing an incredible transformation, the character assumes the identity of a true Gaucho.

notes.title: Unveiling the Boitatá: The mystical character from Gaucho and the Grassland.
notes.content:
Get ready to unravel the mysteries of Boitatá and understand its importance in Gaucho culture. And be prepared to embark on an exciting adventure, full of challenges and riddles, as you explore the vast plains of the Pampas and discover the hidden secrets of this place.

At the center of the journey lies the legendary Boitatá, a being that guards the passage to a mystical world, and those who wish to enter this universe must prove their skill by defeating it in a legendary duel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/3017ba0f33e20d57819785b74efc4ca4b00d248d.jpg[/img]

Its mastery over fire creates a formidable challenge for any daring player, but the reward for overcoming it is truly extraordinary. By triumphing over this mythical creature, the player gains entry to a new world, a mystical and unique land filled with exclusive items.

In the new world, the player is greeted by new characters, such as the Shaman, discovers powerful items, and faces even greater challenges in their journey.

[b]The Boitatá in mythology:[/b] it’s depicted as a giant serpent with shining scales that emits intense light, making it a unique creature. In Gaucho mythology, it is described as a fire serpent with shining eyes and a frightening appearance.

Its mystical representation and the challenges it presents to players add a fascinating layer to the game's narrative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/a85100ff45de064d106d3452b6a783aed1da9fbe.png[/img]

Known for protecting a sacred relic capable of bringing balance and prosperity to the land, Boitatá becomes an obstacle to be overcome.

Throughout the game, players face challenges related to Boitatá, and to advance in the story, they must construct three totems, which are crafted from specific items collected throughout the game and then placed in the Boitatá’s domain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/53768ca8b7c77859413bc5545d9714467d0e3c7a.png[/img]

Courage and skill are also required to confront the imposing fire guardian, and remember, if Boitatá finds you, you'll have to start all over again.

In addition to all the activities, local legends, and challenges that the game offers, one of the most adorable features is the animals, and they are divided into three different categories, which are:

They also provide support and assist in various tasks.

notes.title: The new 360° rotation camera of Gaucho and the Grassland.
notes.content:
Moving the camera or not in a game can make the player pay more or less attention to it. And that's why riding through the pampas(grasslands) just got better and more immersive with Gaucho and the Grassland's 360° free rotation camera.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/6bda247cc07366db4e32d108f4b1d63d97d7671d.gif[/img]

The game, which is inspired by several other games such as Animal Crossing for example, followed the traditional line of farming games with a fixed camera, but even considering that despite doing a good job presenting the game world to the players, the fixed camera was not having an interesting differential for the final version.

With the change in the format from fixed to 360º, the player has greater freedom when exploring the mysteries of the universe, building the ranch, taking care of the animals and has greater control when it comes to customization, whether by mouse or joystick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/4e6da1488ac4cedf156f82bbbd6844eb731e9738.png[/img]

[b]The change
[/b]

After listening to the public, the idea came up to change the game's camera restriction and thus develop the 360º orbital camera around the character.

Some feedback was received and along with our own questions it was decided that the camera controls should be more immersive and interesting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/252f3d6ac9bfacb8ab10f97c6db6dc968eef3d5f.gif[/img]

Tests will start in the next demos and it will be possible to see how the public will interact with this type of camera instead of the fixed version.

The next step was to adjust the camera so that it could rotate freely, thus giving players maximum freedom to explore the pampas and other future biomes in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/ec4158ffc597ca6c0ad466d337ac903328702978.png[/img]

This camera behaviour also applies to indoor environments, maintaining freedom of exploration and avoiding that occasional annoying object that blocks your vision and makes life difficult.

You can test this update in the next demo and leave your feedback, remembering that your feedback is very important for our updates to be even better in the future.

notes.title: A new legend and the next quest of Gaucho and the Grassland
notes.content:
He inhabits one of the regions of the mystic world, a character as mysterious as the universe he lives in, this is the Pajé, the new character of Gaucho and the Grassland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/f6a56cbff069ac4c1c328784eb9ebd447f46fe8a.png[/img]
[i]Pajé 
[/i]
After driving the Boitatá away from the grasslands, the player gains access to the mystic world, where he finds the Pajé, the manifestation of a local entity that lives in a magical place.

Even without a direct relationship with other characters in the village, this character has a special mission for the player, with the main objective being to help him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/a781fa128cc2a062ca8a2c1d0a15d328fc01de51.png[/img]
[i]Character's dwelling
[/i]
The Pajé has an important item that has disappeared, so he needs the player's help to find it, and as soon as the mysterious item is found a reward is granted, both to the player and to the whole world.

It is up to the player to interact with the character or not, but it is important to remember that each interaction has different consequences.

Legend has it that in a cave in the middle of the forest lived an ancient chief with his daughter, Yari. However, with the approaching old age, there was also a concern: who would be his successor in the tribe, since he had only one female daughter?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/6a81c0918726a06e82a2c3c33d424cb75ebd64b7.png[/img]
[i]Pajé 
[/i]

For this, the former chief ended up choosing the most handsome and tall of the native people of his tribe, the same one with whom Yari was in love. However, with a noble attitude, Yari ended up not getting married, staying by the side of her old father, since if she got married, she should leave with her husband wherever he went.

One day an old Pajé arrived at the tribe and saw Yari's sadness for having left her great love and ended up asking her what would be her wish so that she could be happy again, and the girl promptly replied that her request was for the Pajé to give strength to her father.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/1bb187da52d471e2a81fdef4a14fe6beca75e98e.png[/img]
[i]Pajé 
[/i]

Promptly, the Pajé who was sent by Tupã grabbed a leaf and gave it to the chief, so that he could make a drink and recover his strength. Immediately after drinking it, the chief regained his strength, and was able to accompany his tribe for a much longer time.

Yari was then transformed into a Goddess whose task was to teach humanity to cultivate the plant and live in peace.

That is why, today, yerba mate is a symbol of fraternity and peaceful coexistence among human beings and is still shared among all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/81c53013b9135a5420056b34c8c41b52b42767e3.png[/img]
[i]Pajé 
[/i]

notes.title: Development of the new main character - Creating the "Gaucha".
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/f941b53b806b24953521738b55b91566067dcacf.png[/img]

The process of developing a new character can be more time consuming than it seems, this is because it requires a lot of study, research and motivation. Our new character has some characteristics that are very specific and strong according to the main theme of the game, the way of moving or dressing, the sayings in the local dialect and the physical aspects were all thought to give a experience as close to real as possible.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41240717/44781a2c7e45ecf00356a71659cf098101849b6a.png[/img]

The creation of "Gaucha" gave a new look to the game, because now women can feel more represented, in addition to being able to choose the clothes that they like the most among the available options, she can still ride a horse, hunt bulls with the lasso, gather materials to build a house, create unique items and even face the mystical zone with great simplicity and bravery.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41240717/dd2ed15de397e493959f06b5cab93262be94ee1c.png[/img]

The creation of this character was very important and significant, as it is always a challenge when dealing with a specific culture, the care with clothes, hair, language used and way of walking, for example, were thought out with care, and seeing each completed step of this challenge was incredible, and left the whole team very satisfied with the final result.
